88633.title: Revenue tile shows the exact amount to the cent and equals the Sales report
88633.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in a quiet test location: nobody else invoices, issues credits or clocks time there this week; on the Dashboard, the Revenue tile on This Week reads $0.00 with 0 Invoices.
  3. You run the whole case on one day, and not on the last evening of the week, so every record you create stays inside This Week.
  4. A test customer with one contact and one asset that uses that contact (for example ZZAUTOTEST Dash Customer 1, contact Dana Test, unit ZZ-101).
  5. An in-stock inventory part with a Sell price (for example $200.00).
  6. Invoice 1 for that customer (not sent, not paid): one approved labor line (for example 10.00 hours at a rate from the list) and a flat Discount (for example $100.00). You have written down its Subtotal (before any discount and before tax).
  7. Invoice 2 for the same customer (not sent, not paid): one approved labor line (for example 2.00 hours) with the part from 5 added (quantity 1, In stock). You have written down its Subtotal.
  8. A credit on invoice 2 that returns the part, Outcome Store Credit. You have written down its amount before tax.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list; pick ZZAUTOTEST Dashboard Quiet (it already exists and charges 0 % shop supplies). Check: Dashboard > Revenue tile > range pill > This Week: it reads $0.00 with 0 Invoices. If it does not, try another location in the list. Locations cannot be deleted, so do not create another one: if no location is quiet this week, mark the case Blocked and write in the result comment that no quiet location was free this week.
  • For 4: Customers > New Customer > Name > Save; on its Contacts tab: New Contact; add an asset (Add beside Asset in the New Work Order window, or the customer's Assets tab) and pick that contact in the asset's Contact field.
  • For 5: Parts > Inventory (pick a part with stock on hand, or use New Inventory Part).
  • For 6 and 7: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and an Asset (Add beside either if needed) > Save (if a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create); set Service Advisor to Advisor A in the left panel; in the New Line window (> New Line on the Lines tab for each further line): What Are You Doing? (any text), Add Technician (any), Labor Rate (any rate in the list, for example EVR Travel to EVO ($100 an hour)), Estimated Time and Tech Time, tick Line Approved > Save & Close. Discount (invoice 1): three dots at the top right of the Lines tab > Add Work Order Fee / Discount > Type Discount, the flat amount > Add Discount. Part (invoice 2): on the line click Add Part and choose the inventory part (it must show In stock). Then on the line click Story (Add tech story for this line) > type a short story > Update; click Complete (if a Missing Details window asks for Mileage, enter one > Complete All Lines); click Mark Reviewed; Finance tab > Create Invoice; close the New Customer Payment window without paying (do not send or pay the invoice). The Subtotal is on the Finance tab.
  • For 8: invoice 2's Finance tab > the invoice's three dots > Issue Credit > choose the part, Outcome Store Credit > save. The credit shows on Customers > the customer > Invoices tab (turn Open only off if you cannot see it).
88633.custom_steps:
1. Work out Revenue by hand: invoice 1 subtotal + invoice 2 subtotal - the credit = $1,250.00 + $480.00 - $200.00 = $1,530.00 (use your own figures if they differ).
  2. Click Dashboard in the top menu.
  3. On the Revenue tile click the range pill and choose This Week.
  4. Write down the Revenue figure exactly as shown.
  5. Click the arrow icon beside "Revenue" on the tile (its tooltip names the report).
  6. On the Sales report, make sure the Date control shows This week. If it does not, choose This week.
  7. Write down the Subtotal in the Totals row at the bottom of the table.
88633.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Revenue figure equals your hand total exactly. With the example data it reads $1,530.00 ($1,250.00 + $480.00 - $200.00): the $100.00 discount is not taken off and the tax is not added.
  • The figure shows dollars and cents (e.g. $1,530.00), not a rounded whole-dollar amount.
  • The Sales report for the same location and the same week shows the same amount in its Totals row Subtotal as the Revenue tile.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9575 (S3), story SV-9576 (S4); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, S3 (S3-R1, S3-R2 Revenue row, context note), S4 (S4-R2). Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, captured 2026-09-28) used for on-screen labels and navigation only: boards 02_Last12_After, 03_Range_After, 10_sales_After.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R2: “Each measure is calculated as defined in the table below.”
  • S3-R2 table row (Revenue): “| Revenue | Sum of invoice subtotals in the selected range, before any discount and before tax, minus credit memos. Shown to the cent. | Sales report |”
  • S4-R2: “The Revenue tile headline is the total revenue for the selected range, shown as a dollar amount to the cent.”
  • S3-R1: “Every figure the dashboard shows for a measure equals the figure the measure's matching report shows for the same workplace, date range, and filters. This holds at every moment, not merely in principle. The dashboard may serve a figure from a cache, but only in a way that cannot produce a difference: the tile and its report must resolve to the same stored calculation, or the cache must be invalidated by the same events that change the report's answer. A tile that shows a different number from its report because one of them is more recently computed than the other is a defect, not an accepted staleness window. There is no freshness allowance and no "up to N minutes behind" in this spec.”
  • S3 context note (parity check): “to check parity on a KPI tile that shows a shop-wide figure, compare it against the matching report with all advisors or all technicians selected (no filter applied).”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
